title: Protection of a deliberately bought position after the operator script exits

options.name: Keep current behaviour: the script arms protection in its own process and exits
options.risk: Every landed deliberate buy is unprotected (no exit, no anti-rug) until the main bot is next started; if the main bot was already running it never picks the position up until restarted (S0).

options.name: Hand the position to the running main bot
options.behavior_impact: The main bot picks up new pending buys while running (for example a periodic re-scan of pending rows without a monitor, or an explicit handoff flag), so protection does not depend on the script.
options.risk: A re-scan must not double-arm positions it already monitors; needs its own interval and idempotency test.

options.name: Refuse to run while the main bot runs, and tell the operator loudly to start the bot right after the buy
options.behavior_impact: Only one process signs for the wallet at a time; the boot resume arms the new position.
options.risk: Still depends on the operator acting on the message; the position is unprotected until the bot starts.

options.name: Keep the script running and monitoring until the position is closed
options.behavior_impact: The script becomes a second long-lived trading process for that position.
options.risk: Two processes sign for one wallet without a shared nonce lock (RC-18); closing the terminal kills protection again.

recommendation: handoff-to-running-bot, combined with the refuse-while-running guard for the period before the handoff exists; decide together with RC-18 (out-of-process signer).
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S0/S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides how a manual buy gets exit and rug protection.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
interim_rule: Operator ruling ESC-BUY-01 (acknowledge-continue, severity S0 kept): until this is fixed, after any landed deliberate buy start (or restart) the main bot immediately so its boot resume arms the exit monitor and anti-rug for the new position.
